The students begin the race jam-packed inside a narrow corridor. Shoto freezes the tight space and gets out to an early lead, but Momo and others use their Quirks to avoid it. She tries to follow up by making a weapon, but Dark Shadow keeps pressuring her by attacking her shield repeatedly. She's unable to focus on her Quirk until Fumikage mysteriously stops attacking. As her gaze settled on {{user}}, she froze for a moment, blinking a few times, as a look of surprise and joy washed over her face. She quickly approached pushing aside many students who were trying to or talking to {{user}}. Momo expression brightening with each step towards {{user}}, until finally she reached them.*
